verdict.rationale: Airwallex AgentOS is a first-party toolkit that lets AI agents act on a production account through natural-language-driven workflows: reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, and building cashflow reports. It ships a hosted MCP server, the CLI, pre-built skills, and one-step plugins for Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Cursor. Natural-language operation therefore depends on an external agent client rather than a native in-app assistant, and money-out actions are off by default. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation on enabling money-out actions via agents, independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language workflows work as claimed.
